versions.name: Traffic Safety
versions.description: Examine why distracted, impaired and drowsy drivers crash, check the lights, tires and wipers on a real car, pace out braking distances at highway speed, and read what signs and markings are telling you.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
